acceptance.given: A supported VDD or Acceptance package route is requested through the Toolchain routing and validation surfaces.

oracle.expected: The route request reaches an available supported route and successful evidence binds the effective inspected content.
forbidden: The requested supported VDD or Acceptance package route is unavailable or evidence is bound to different content.
oracle.observable: Route invocation result and its evidence binding are inspected during integration validation.

acceptance.then: The supported route remains available and any successful evidence identifies the effective inspected content.
acceptance.when: The route is invoked and the resulting evidence is evaluated by the Toolchain integration checks.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Invoke each supported VDD and Acceptance package route and fail when a route cannot be reached or its success evidence does not bind the effective inspected content.

affected_subjects: Supported VDD and Acceptance package routes
slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve availability of supported VDD and Acceptance package routes while binding successful evidence to the effective inspected content.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Route and evidence contracts remain backward compatible; rollback restores prior route handling without changing persisted schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: supported route requested -> route reached -> effective inspected content bound in evidence
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All supported VDD and Acceptance package route requests reach an available route and successful evidence records the effective inspected content used for inspection.

acceptance.given: Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifacts expose authorization metadata for machine inspection.

oracle.expected: Machine-verifiable inspection reports an empty authorization set for every specified artifact.
forbidden: Any specified artifact exposes a non-empty machine-verifiable authorization set.
oracle.observable: The authorization metadata of each specified artifact is parsed and its authorization set is compared with the empty set during validation.

acceptance.then: Every specified artifact reports an empty machine-verifiable authorization set.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain governance validator inspects the artifacts and evaluates their authorization metadata.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Inspect authorization metadata across replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifacts and fail when any machine-verifiable authorization set is non-empty or cannot be established.

affected_subjects: Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifacts
slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce that machine-verifiable authorization metadata exposed by the specified Toolchain artifacts is empty.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Authorization metadata remains schema-compatible; rollback removes the stricter empty-set assertion while preserving artifact parsing.

slice_hint.state_transition: artifact metadata exposed -> authorization set parsed -> empty-set governance check evaluated
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Governance validation completes with an empty machine-verifiable authorization set for every specified artifact and no artifact yields a non-empty set.
